name: Χ:Khi ~Silence E.V.E.~
source:
It's been half a year since high schooler Shizumo Misora got caught up in that incident and was rescued.
Thanks to his roommate, Kaname Mana, who cared for him night and day, he slowly got back to living a normal life.
But, he was living as a "woman" now.
And there were precious people around him who smiled at him.
Even though all these changes left Misora confused, he felt relieved, like maybe things could be peaceful again thanks to everyone's warmth.
As if to make sure he believed his new reality was indeed real, a man forced himself on Misora, and then said:

"You're the perfect Eve."

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080408150338/http://site-r.jp/pro/x-pro/story.htm]the official website[/url]]
translation:
高中生南空静茂被卷入这次事件并获救，已经过去半年了。
感谢室友小真名的日夜照顾，他慢慢恢复了正常的生活。
但是，他现在却以“女人”的身份生活着。
而他身边还有一些珍贵的人对他微笑。
尽管这一切的变化让南空感到困惑，但他还是松了口气，似乎因为大家的温暖，事情又可以恢复平静了。
仿佛是为了确认自己的新现实确实是真实的，一名男子将自己强压在南空身上，然后说道：

“你是完美的伊芙。”

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080408150338/http://site-r.jp/pro/x-pro/story.htm]官网[/url]]
